featured_reviews.name: Ravi Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
With Love and Support from an NRI/RNOR from the USA

Evaluation and Recommendation for Suryadev Yadav
My experience working with Suryadev over the past several months—across U.S. tax filings, Indian tax compliance, lower TDS certification, and the sale of residential property—has been nothing short of exceptional. Navigating Indian tax laws during a property sale is notoriously complex, often confusing, and for most NRIs, a genuinely stressful and intimidating process.

Through every stage, his expertise, clarity, and calm professionalism transformed what could have been a harrowing ordeal into a journey I could manage with confidence and peace of mind.

🌟 Mastery of Cross Border Taxation
His understanding of U.S. tax requirements, NRI/RNOR tax residency rules, and India–U.S. tax interplay is rare. He handled my U.S. tax filings with precision, ensuring every disclosure, form, and compliance requirement was addressed correctly. His ability to explain complex tax concepts in simple, actionable terms made decision making easy and transparent.

🛡️ Expertise in Lower TDS Certificate and Indian Tax Compliance
Obtaining a Lower TDS Certificate is one of the most critical and sensitive steps for an NRI selling property in India. He managed the entire process end to end—preparation, documentation, representation, and follow through—with meticulous attention to detail.
•	He anticipated potential issues before they surfaced.
•	He coordinated seamlessly with the Income Tax Department.
•	He ensured that the TDS deducted was accurate, compliant, and minimized within the legal framework.
His guidance on capital gains, advance tax, TDS refunds, and documentation for repatriation was thorough and reliable. Every rupee was accounted for, every form was correct, and every deadline was met.

🤝 Support for My Sister’s Flat Sale and TDS Issues
What truly sets him apart is not just his technical skill but his humanity. When my sister faced her own flat sale and TDS complications, he stepped in with the same level of care, diligence, and professionalism. He treated her situation as if it were his own family’s, ensuring she was protected, informed, and supported at every step.

💬 Communication, Integrity, and Professionalism
Throughout the process, he demonstrated:
•	Clear and timely communication
•	Absolute integrity in every interaction
•	Patience in explaining rules and options
•	Responsiveness even during time sensitive or stressful moments
•	A solutions oriented mindset that never left me feeling lost or overwhelmed

❤️ Personal Impact
Selling a flat in India as an NRI is not just a financial transaction—it is an emotional journey filled with uncertainty, fear of mistakes, and the weight of compliance. His work gave me something far more valuable than just tax clarity: He gave me peace of mind. Because of his guidance, I can now leave India with gratitude, strength, and a sense of closure. The anxiety I once felt around Indian tax systems has been replaced with trust and confidence.

⭐ Final Recommendation
I recommend Suryadev wholeheartedly and without reservation. His expertise is world class, his ethics are impeccable, and his dedication to his clients is extraordinary. He is worth every rupee I paid him—and far more. Any NRI seeking a trustworthy, knowledgeable, and compassionate CA will find in him not just a professional, but a true partner and protector in their financial journey.
